title: Establish management account and organizational structure
Establish ownership for billing, security, and operations
gap_reason: Process/organizational check — no single API to validate ownership assignments

title: Establish boundaries and scopes for your environments
Establish a strategy for experimental and temporary environments
check_logic: Verify Sandbox OU and/or Suspended OU exist (case-insensitive name match)

title: Protect account root users, and establish alternate contacts
check_logic: AccountAccessKeysPresent == 0 AND AccountMFAEnabled == 1 AND alternate contacts configured

title: Use strong sign-in mechanisms
check_logic: All IAM users (if any) have MFA devices attached

title: Employ a centralized identity provider
Establish controls to manage access based on lifecycle
gap_reason: Process check — joiners/movers/leavers lifecycle not API-verifiable

title: Grant least privilege access
check_logic: Check for AdministratorAccess attached to non-break-glass roles; check IAM Access Analyzer findings count

title: Define permission guardrails for your organization
Implement data perimeter controls to help prevent unintended access
gap_reason: Requires VPC endpoint policy analysis — complex, architecture-specific

title: Audit and rotate credentials periodically
check_logic: No access keys older than 90 days; no unused keys

title: Establish a process to continually review and refine permissions
check_logic: IAM Access Analyzer org service enabled (access-analyzer.amazonaws.com)

title: Establish workload and machine identity federation
gap_reason: Workload-specific — requires per-workload OIDC/IRSA configuration analysis

title: Define observability standards and policies
Establish central, cross-account observability capabilities
check_logic: Config Aggregator exists with organization-level source

title: Implement standardized attribution policies
check_logic: Tag Policy enabled

title: Establish an organization view of cloud inventory and dependencies
check_logic: Config org service enabled (config.amazonaws.com)

title: Establish standard repositories of shared resources and patterns
gap_reason: Organizational practice — Service Catalog usage varies, not one-size-fits-all

title: Implement mechanisms for patch management
gap_reason: Requires SSM inventory across member accounts — multi-account Phase 2+

title: Establish service quota management
check_logic: Service Quotas alarms configured for critical services

title: Establish centralized backup standards and mechanisms
check_logic: Backup Policy enabled AND backup.amazonaws.com org service enabled

title: Establish cross-Region replication and failover capabilities
gap_reason: Architecture-specific — varies per workload, not org-level checkable

title: Establish resilience testing tooling
gap_reason: Process check — FIS usage is workload-specific

title: Establish emergency access mechanisms
check_logic: Role named *emergency* or *break-glass* exists with appropriate trust policy

title: Configure audit logging of cloud operations
Configure standardized locations for logs, traces, and metrics
check_logic: Log Archive account exists

title: Maintain an auditable cloud inventory record
Remediate non-compliant resources
check_logic: Non-compliant Config rule count; remediation actions configured

title: Implement threat detection mechanisms
check_logic: GuardDuty org service enabled (guardduty.amazonaws.com)

title: Employ vulnerability and patch management controls
check_logic: Inspector enabled at org level

title: Establish security tooling for investigating incidents
check_logic: Security Hub org service enabled (securityhub.amazonaws.com)

title: Prepare forensics capabilities
gap_reason: Requires dedicated forensics account — org-specific design choice

title: Establish encryption and key management standards
check_logic: KMS customer-managed keys exist; default S3 encryption configured

check_logic: Tag Policy enabled (supports cost allocation tagging)

title: Configure billing and cost management tools
check_logic: Cost Optimization Hub org service enabled

title: Establish organizational metrics to track optimization efforts

title: Build strategies for commitment discounts and volume-based pricing
gap_reason: Business decision — Savings Plans/RI strategy is customer-specific

gap_reason: Architecture-specific — TGW vs VPC peering vs PrivateLink varies per customer
